title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Reports 2026 First Quarter Results
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today reported financial and operating results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. For the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, the Company reported Net Income of $5.2 million, or $0.07 per diluted share, and Net Income of $6.8 million, or $0.09 per diluted share, respectively.
